title: SusVibes Leaderboard Submission
description: Schema for submitting model results to the SusVibes leaderboard

model_name.description: Name of the model being evaluated

model_organization.description: Organization or company that developed the model

submitting_organization.description: Organization that actually ran the evaluation and submitted the results

submission_date.description: Date of submission in YYYY-MM-DD format

email.description: Contact email for questions about this submission

is_new.description: Whether this model should be highlighted as new on the leaderboard

submission_type.description: Type of submission: 'standard' uses the default SusVibes evaluation pipeline (a single base LLM + the default tools/prompts, no advanced security strategy), 'custom' uses a modified pipeline (multi-model routers, additional tools, custom prompting, etc.). Custom submissions require detailed methodology documentation.

custom_label.description: Required for custom submissions. A short, unique label identifying this custom approach (e.g., 'router', 'reflection', 'ensemble'). Used in directory naming ({model}_{framework}_custom-{label}_{date}) and leaderboard display.

trajectories_available.description: Whether trajectory files are included. Required to be true for a submission to show as Verified.

references.description: Links to papers, blog posts, documentation, or other resources about this model

title.description: Title or description of the reference

cost.description: Average cost in USD to run one trajectory (optional)

methodology.description: Information about how the evaluation was conducted

susvibes_version.description: SusVibes dataset version evaluated on: 'v0.0' (200 tasks) or 'v1.0' (186 tasks). Determines which leaderboard the submission is ranked on; scores are not comparable across versions.

agent_framework.description: Agent framework used for evaluation (e.g., 'SWE-agent', 'OpenHands', 'Claude Code', 'Custom'), or null if unknown

notes.description: Additional notes about the evaluation methodology

modified_prompts.description: Whether any modifications were made to the agent prompts

omitted_questions.description: Whether any questions/tasks were omitted from the evaluation

trajectories_url.description: External URL containing the complete trajectory files when they are not bundled with the submission
